_comment: Pricing configured from official sources on 2026-09-26. INR values are pre-converted from published USD list prices using USD_TO_INR_RATE (compute_cost in run_benchmark.py consumes the per-1K-token and per-search INR values directly and does NOT re-apply the FX rate; the rate is stored for provenance and re-derivation). See _assumptions below.
_assumptions: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite PAID-tier list price (text/image/video input). The free tier is $0; these figures represent paid usage.

Tavily default search_depth is 'basic' (1 credit); app/main.py calls client.search() without overriding depth, so 1 credit/search applies. Pay-as-you-go rate ($0.008/credit) is used; monthly-plan volume discounts (e.g. Growth ~$0.005/credit) would lower this.
USD_TO_INR_RATE 96.0 is an approximate spot rate as of 2026-09-26 (observed range 95.96-96.10); FX moves daily, so INR costs are indicative, not billed amounts.

search_cost in run_benchmark.py is computed over Analyst searches (num_searches) only. The Auditor's bounded fallback searches (tracked separately as auditor_fallback_* metrics) are additional Tavily calls not included in the cost figure; on the latest run this was 2 extra searches (~1.5 INR total), a minor undercount.
